quote: We examine how quantifiers are represented in NLU benchmarks, and how their occurrence at test time contributes to errors by neural language models.
We report the test set performance using accuracy (and F1/EM for QA) as evaluation metrics.
We fine‑tune BERT and RoBERTa on NLI and QA tasks; no language model is used as a post‑generation judge.
We manually create 100 premise‑hypothesis pairs for the GQNLI dataset; there is no human evaluation of generated outputs.
